newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P says Reliance outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P says Reliance outlook positive.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Thursday it has revised the foreign currency rating outlook for Reliance Industries Ltd to positive from stable and affirmed the BB-plus foreign currency rating on the company's long term debt.
S&P said the rating and outlook followed similar action in relation to the Republic of India.
"Reliance, India's largest private sector company, has grown rapidly to become a highly integrated producer of polyester fibre, textiles and plastic polymers," S&P said.

"The company is expected to maintain adequate credit protection in the context of its national enviroment by virtue of its modern, efficient plants, very strong domestic market postion, and willingness to fund aggressive growth, in part, with periodic equity issues," the ratings agency said.
S&P said the company had several substantial facilities under construction which were subject to normal commissioning risks and the unpredictable nature of chemical prices.
However, it said these risks were mitigated by a solid financial profile, an anticipated highly competitive cost position, and a strong track record of successfully bringing plants on stream.
